incidents.name: LeverageUsingSiloFlashloanWithGeneralSwap unvalidated swap target
incidents.notes: openLeveragePosition() on the unreleased leverage helper accepted a caller-supplied flashloan target and swap calldata without constraining them to the selected Silo market, so a fake flash lender's onFlashLoan callback made the helper call the real WETH Silo's borrow() on behalf of a third party that had granted it debt-receive approval.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the verified LeverageUsingSiloFlashloanWithGeneralSwap at 0xCbEe4617ABF667830fe3ee7DC8d6f46380829DF9, deployed by Silo 0x6d228fa4dad2163056a48fc2186d716f5c65e89a seven days before the incident and unrelated to the attack sender; 224 WETH was borrowed out of Silo 0x160287E2D3fdCDE9E91317982fc1Cc01C1f94085 against borrower 0x60BAF994f44dd10c19C0c47cbFE6048a4fFe4860
